notes: The new EngQuest app: rebuilt from scratch, with a bell for news and optional notifications.
A brand-new app, built just for Android phones
Send your task photos even with no signal: they go when you are back online
A bell for news: approved tasks, XP, attendance and announcements
Optional notifications: choose which ones buzz your phone
Scores, Level/XP, Materials, Vocabulary and more, all inside the app
After updating, pick your class and name once more
Submit page: choose Take photo (camera) or From gallery
Pick many photos from your gallery at once (up to 10)
New Updates page — see what's new before you install, instead of a blank download
The Download button installs the app for you
Smoother updates: the app downloads and opens the installer for you
No more browser or duplicate downloaded files
Added the menu button (top-left) for the full menu: Assignments, Attendance, Reading, Vocabulary, Strikes, and more
A real app feel with a bottom menu bar: Home, Materials, Submit, Scores, Me
Your grade is remembered — no more grade-choosing every time
The back button remembers where you were
